title: The World Editor stands on its own
text:
The World Editor is now a separate app with a professional workbench, and it runs without the game, even straight from your computer.

✨ The World Editor is its own app at /editor. The world is built into the editor file, so it opens instantly and works without loading the game
✨ Download the editor (File › Download this editor) and open it straight from your computer, even offline. It connects to your realm only to load, preview and publish
✨ A new workbench: Hierarchy and Assets on the left, an Inspector with sections on the right, Problems, History and Output below, rulers, a document tab and a status bar that shows your connection to the realm
⬆️ The map now shows the land's real relief, so hills, valleys and shores are easy to read
⬆️ Every panel can be resized or hidden (Ctrl+B, Ctrl+J, Ctrl+I), and the editor remembers your layout
⬆️ The editor marks changes that are not published yet, and warns you when your realm runs a newer version than the editor
